prompt:
Create a faithful illustrated 2D fighting game full-body sprite atlas of THE FEAR from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004), original PS2 model, NOT Delta or HD reinterpretation. Exact original identity and outfit from reference original-promo-0044 and PS2 intro: tall wiry muscular pale adult man, severe angular clean-shaven face, short black slicked-back hair with conspicuous WHITE streaks at BOTH temples, pronounced widow peak, no long ponytail. LONG-SLEEVED military fatigues matching the source: brown-olive khaki base covered by dark charcoal-black irregular tiger camouflage stripes, pointed open collar, same camo trousers. FULL dark black-blue gloves and dark lace-up combat boots. Never bare chest or bare arms, no torn shirt, no gold armor. BLACK shoulder webbing/chest harness with tall central vertical ribbed rectangular BLACK chest quiver/pouch block and small silver buckles, not an armored plate carrier. Olive khaki rectangular pouch at ANATOMICAL RIGHT front hip, smaller rear/belt fittings, dark belt, long narrow slack black webbing strap ends near legs. Anatomical RIGHT hip pouch must remain RIGHT on both independently drawn views. Outfit from original reference, not Naked Snake's rolled sleeves, not The Sorrow sweater, not remake.

For poses 0..2 the reference compact crossbow is LITTLE JOE: matte black small pistol-grip crossbow held in anatomical RIGHT hand, thin exposed straight central bolt rail, SHORT squared paired bow limbs connected in a triangular/trapezoid braced frame, thin taut black string across ends. No rifle barrel, magazine, optic, laser, gun stock, arrow quiver on back, fantasy large bow or firearm. Preserve exact depicted original mechanical silhouette; compact rail length about one forearm. No loaded loose flying arrow, no muzzle flash, no supernatural aura. Crossbow stays attached to gripping hand.

Make exactly TWELVE isolated complete figures of the SAME character, 4 columns x 3 rows equal INVISIBLE cells, row-major. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha PNG, WIDE landscape atlas. Generous transparent gutters at least 25 native pixels around each full figure, weapons, fingers, boot, strap and hair and at outer edges; 12 clearly separate alpha components. No text, labels, numbers, visible grid, background, ground shadow, trees, other people or detached props. Consistent upright source body scale in all cells; crouch and air tuck must remain physically smaller, never enlarge low postures. Detailed painted style, controlled dark contour, restrained realistic original palette, orthographic side view with modest three-quarter torso to see original gear. ALL 12 directly FACE SCREEN RIGHT; head/nose, feet and movement RIGHT. Each view is drawn independently; do not mirror source or swap anatomical hands or equipment sides.


POSE ORDER exactly: 0 Little Joe shoot startup: LEFT free hand near chest, anatomically RIGHT gloved hand raises compact black pistol crossbow to shoulder height and aims SCREEN RIGHT; 1 Little Joe shoot ACTIVE: anatomically RIGHT arm holds compact SHORT pistol crossbow fully FORWARD SCREEN RIGHT at chest/neck height, LEFT arm bends near torso, straight short bolt rail and bowstring toward leading end clearly visible, small bow wholly attached to hand, no arrow released yet; 2 Little Joe shoot recovery lowers compact crossbow slightly and draws right wrist back, left hand ready. 3 snare preparation: crouches low, LEFT hand reaches belt to gather a thin dark rope line while RIGHT compact crossbow is held close chest/down thigh; 4 snare deployment ACTIVE: crouches extremely low with legs compressed, LEFT empty fingers open just above ground directly IN FRONT screen RIGHT at toe level placing a small loop of thin dark snare rope connected to gloved fingers, RIGHT compact bow retained tucked torso, no metallic mine, no detonation; 5 snare recovery rise halfway from crouch while drawing LEFT hand back, small bow retained right. 6 camouflage activation: upright tense guard LEFT fingertips touch central chest harness fitting, RIGHT keeps Little Joe by hip; fully opaque visible character, no glow or fading. 7 William Tell heavy crossbow preparation: both hands support a distinctly LONGER black full-size original crossbow, restrained dark shoulder butt/stock and longer straight central bolt rail, broad squared/braced bow limb frame at forward end, RIGHT hand at rear trigger grip and LEFT under forward rail; aim screen RIGHT at chest height. 8 William Tell crossbow ACTIVE: two-handed fully level aimed long crossbow forward SCREEN RIGHT, modest shoulder bracing, clearly larger than one-handed Little Joe in row 0, long bolt rail/bow front mouth fully visible, no firearm barrel, optic, laser or magazine, no released arrows or muzzle flashes; 9 long crossbow recovery draw it down diagonally close torso maintaining two-handed grip, no second floating or duplicated crossbow. 10 breath recovery crouched with shoulders hunching, LEFT empty hand rests chest/harness, RIGHT compact Little Joe by thigh, mouth closed no food or cigarette; 11 breath recovery rises and inhales/steadies shoulders, same compact bow retained low. NO OTHER poses and no extra weapons. Exactly12 distinct isolated full bodies, all head/nose/toes consistently FACE SCREEN RIGHT. Equipment silhouettes original PS2 and references, no Delta. Larger bow unseen details understated practical black mechanisms, no fantasy inventions. All72 authored keyframes are versus adaptations, not extracted original animations.
